ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio; predominantly high-intensity white pixels with a dense overlay of low-intensity black linear patterns across approximately 100% of the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity field covering both lobes, characterized by a complex network of low-intensity linear vectors. Darker pixel concentrations are mapped at the peduncle interface and along the serrated trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated 45-55 degree pixel angle dividing the symmetrical lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular sawtooth pattern along the continuous trailing edge; pixel-amplitude variations are high, particularly on the outer distal halves of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex leading edge geometry transitioning to a tapering, slightly concave sweep at the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Roughly circular clusters of low-intensity pixels and irregular protrusions are visible at the extreme lateral tips (distal edges) of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense, criss-crossing network of distinct, unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) covering nearly the entire visible high-intensity ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across the ventral surface and significant irregular serrations/trauma along the trailing edge boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme density and high-contrast nature of the linear abrasion patterns provide a highly unique visual texture compared to standard pigmentation.
